**Part B — Replace all 4 call sites** in `Program.cs` (`WaitForElement`, `ParseSelectorArgs`, `ResolveFindScope`'s scope-strategy check, `ResolveElement`) to call this helper instead of raw `Enum.TryParse`, each returning/writing `invalid-argument` with the new message on failure — same error code already used, just now reachable for these three strategies too.
